title: Prorated Share of a Defective Tire — Tire Sets & Treadwear Limited Warranty
content:
**Prorated share of a defective tire — Tire Sets & Treadwear Limited Warranty.** For a workmanship share, the prorated share depends on when and how the free period ended:

1. **Defect found inside the satisfaction trial** — no more than the line's trial days in calendar days after the install date. The tread on a tire that new reflects the defect rather than use, so the prorated share is the miles run times 100 divided by the line's warranted miles.
2. **Defect found after the trial, on a set whose free period ended by time alone** — at least the line's free-replacement months in whole months after the purchase date, with tread worn of at most the line's free-replacement tread worn. The prorated share is the whole months elapsed times 100 divided by the line's warranty term in months.
3. **Any other defect** — the tread worn times 100 divided by the usable tread.

The miles run are the odometer of the inspection entry that records the defect less the install odometer. Days and months are counted to the replacement visit, the date of that inspection entry.

| Line | Trial days | Free months | Free tread worn | Warranted miles | Warranty term |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Crestline Value Touring 40K Treadwear Warranty | 30 days | 12 months | 2/32 in | 40,000 | 48 months |
| Crestline All-Season 50K Treadwear Warranty | 30 days | 12 months | 2/32 in | 50,000 | 60 months |
| Crestline Grand Touring 60K Treadwear Warranty | 45 days | 12 months | 2/32 in | 60,000 | 60 months |
| Crestline Highway Terrain LT 65K Treadwear Warranty | 45 days | 12 months | 2/32 in | 65,000 | 60 months |
| Crestline Premium Touring 75K Treadwear Warranty | 60 days | 12 months | 2/32 in | 75,000 | 72 months |
| Crestline Ultra Touring 85K Treadwear Warranty | 60 days | 24 months | 3/32 in | 85,000 | 72 months |

Trial days in line order: 30, 30, 45, 45, 60, 60.

**Cases (hypothetical 60K-line tires):** found 30 days after installation with 2,400 miles run — 2,400 times 100 divided by 60,000, 4; found 18 months after purchase with 1/32 in worn — 18 times 100 divided by 60, 30; found 18 months after purchase with 4/32 in worn — 4 times 100 divided by 9, 44.44….
